# elevenlabs_convai_phone_number (Resource)

Manages an ElevenLabs ConvAI phone number. Imports an existing Twilio phone number into ElevenLabs for use with ConvAI agents.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `phone_number` (String)
- `telephony_provider` (String)

### Optional

- `assigned_agent` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `twilio_account_sid` (String, Sensitive)
- `twilio_auth_token` (String, Sensitive)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ElevenLabs phone number ID (assigned on import).
- `supports_inbound` (Boolean)
- `supports_outbound` (Boolean)
